# NanoSeedLM

> NanoSeedLM runs mixture-of-experts models in less memory. It replaces stored weights with SeedLM seeds that the GPU expands at run time. It supports IFM/K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B (also as a TransMLA conversion, with a KV cache less than half the size), K2-Horizon-0.9B and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (seed experts). It has a C99 engine with Metal and CUDA kernels. Each Hugging Face model repository has an MLX loader for oMLX or mlx-vlm (Trust Remote Code). Qwen3.8-Flash-Next runs in mlx-vlm and on the CUDA engine (nslm-qwen4-gen). The Metal engine and oMLX do not run it yet. Seed models are not faster or more accurate than affine quantization. They are often a little smaller at similar quality.

Facts to keep in mind:

- The MLA models give up some quality against the original GQA model. Most of the loss comes from a few texts, and the cause is not known.
- The MLX loaders need `mlx_lm.models.k2_horizon`, which oMLX supplies. Stock mlx-lm does not include it.
- Numbers on results pages are dated. The concept pages give the current state.
